_note: Colorado 2026 election cycle: key dates and official links for the November 3, 2026 general election. Each date was read on the official page in key_date_sources on the day in key_date_retrieved. The U.S. Senate, U.S. House and Governor races list every candidate on the state's certified list for the November 3 ballot (roster_source_url on each race), in alphabetical order by last name; write-in candidates are not listed.

key_dates.same_day_registration_general: During early voting and on Election Day

voter_info._note: Read by election reminders (backend/app/services/election_reminders.py) and shown on the Elections tab. Every date has its official source in key_date_sources and the day it was read in key_date_retrieved (data lint E-11, E-12). Checked on the official pages 2026-10-15.

reminder_notes.voter_registration_deadline_general: After that, you can still register in person during early voting and on Election Day.

vote_by_mail_request_deadline_general.reason: Every active registered voter in Colorado is mailed a ballot, so no request is needed.
